_capture.scenario: open on a clean agent — the empty basket every other fixture starts from, and the SHUT opening gate (871 §2.3)
_capture.capturedFrom: The real CallCenterWeb/* handlers in SIS.Api, invoked in-process against the live dev store DB and the real pricing engine; the response is ASP.NET Core's own IResult execution, so the status code and the JSON bytes are the wire's.
_capture.redaction: No real customer or staff identity appears in any fixture on this map.

_notes: 🚩 plantSource is `seededAtOpen` and canAddItem is FALSE. The v1.2 capture of this scenario recorded canAddItem:true on an order whose customer was null and whose plant was labelled `operatorOverride` — a store nobody had chosen, reported as an override nobody made. 871 closed both: the plant is still SEEDED at open (map note 6 is untouched — the engine binds PcHeader.Plant once), the order just no longer claims it can take items.

The gate is `status == open && customer != null && plantSource != seededAtOpen`, and addItem ENFORCES it (NO_CUSTOMER_ATTACHED / STORE_NOT_CHOSEN) — the capability is the report of the gate, not the gate. Fixture 10 drives both halves.

STORE_NOT_CHOSEN rides submitBlockers under the SAME spelling as the refusal: the client has a one-table discipline for chip states and must not grow a second, client-side predicate that can disagree with the server on a live basket.
canOpenAddressBook is false until attachCustomer — the ordering constraint from 137 (CONTRACT.md §6.3).

🚩 header.deliveryType still spells `Delivery`. The sidecar COLUMN now holds the OMS code `D` (owner addendum 2026-07-29: the sidecar holds what the OMS document holds, so the header builder copies rather than translates), but these two values are FROZEN on a frozen field — recoding them on the wire would be a §9 MAJOR and would render `D` at the agent. The mapping lives in CallCenterDeliveryTypes.

v1.4 adds header.paymentType / header.paymentTypeForcedReason and capabilities.canChangePaymentType. paymentType is an INDEPENDENT axis — it is NOT derived from deliveryType, and all four combinations are legal (owner ruling 2026-07-29). forcedReason is null on every phase-1 order.
deliveryFee is quoted on an EMPTY basket too: the fee is a live quote off the current gross, and an empty order is under the threshold like any other.
